description: Implementation of QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager class managing HTTP/3 stream body fragments in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP/3 stream body fragments, tracking received data and providing read access.

methods.name: QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing total body bytes received.

methods.name: OnNonBody
methods.description: Handles non-body bytes, updating fragment state.

methods.name: OnBody
methods.description: Adds a new body fragment and updates total bytes received.

methods.name: OnBodyConsumed
methods.description: Consumes specified number of bytes from the body fragments.

methods.name: PeekBody
methods.description: Provides a view of the current body fragments without consuming them.

methods.name: ReadBody
methods.description: Reads data from body fragments into provided buffers.
